description: Source code for the InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand class, which manages the installation process of OrangeHRM on a new database, including configuration, system checks, user creation, and database setup.

classes.name: InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class for installing OrangeHRM on a new database, handling configuration, system checks, user creation, and database setup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that runs the installation process, handling non-interactive mode and already installed checks.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Performs the sequence of steps for installation: license acceptance, database info, system check, instance creation, admin user creation, and installation.

methods.name: getAppSetupUtility
methods.description: Returns an instance of AppSetupUtility, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: licenseAcceptance
methods.description: Prompts user to accept license terms before proceeding.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Collects database configuration details from the user and validates database connection and user existence.

methods.name: systemCheck
methods.description: Performs system environment checks and prompts user to accept risks if checks fail.

methods.name: instanceCreation
methods.description: Collects organization details, country, language, timezone group, and timezone, then stores them.

methods.name: adminUserCreation
methods.description: Collects admin user details, including name, email, contact, username, password, and registration consent, then stores them.

methods.name: installation
methods.description: Runs the installation steps: database creation, permission checks, migrations, configuration, user creation, and config file setup.
